description: This is a Python script for generating Vulkan SPIR-V shaders, parsing YAML templates, and generating C++ code for shader registration.

classes.name: UniqueKeyLoader
classes.description: Custom YAML loader to handle unique keys in YAML files.

classes.name: SPVGenerator
classes.description: Class responsible for managing shader source files, YAML templates, and generating SPIR-V binaries and GLSL shaders.

classes.name: ShaderInfo
classes.description: Data class holding shader descriptor information such as tile size, layouts, storage types, and registration info.

methods.name: extract_filename
methods.description: Extracts filename from a path, optionally keeping the extension.

methods.name: extract_leading_whitespace
methods.description: Extracts leading whitespace from a line.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes a line for embedding in Python code, handling ${} substitutions.

methods.name: preprocess
methods.description: Processes input text with variable substitutions to produce Python code for shader generation.

methods.name: parse_arg_env
methods.description: Parses environment variable key-value pairs from command line arguments.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Generates a name based on a file path by replacing slashes and dots.

methods.name: isDescriptorLine
methods.description: Checks if a line is a descriptor layout line.

methods.name: isTileSizeLine
methods.description: Checks if a line specifies tile size.

methods.name: findTileSizes
methods.description: Extracts tile size dimensions from a line.

methods.name: isWeightStorageTypeLine
methods.description: Checks if a line specifies weight storage type.

methods.name: getWeightStorageType
methods.description: Extracts weight storage type from a line.

methods.name: isBiasStorageTypeLine
methods.description: Checks if a line specifies bias storage type.

methods.name: getBiasStorageType
methods.description: Extracts bias storage type from a line.

methods.name: isRegisterForLine
methods.description: Checks if a line specifies register registration info.

methods.name: findRegisterFor
methods.description: Extracts registration target and keys from a line.

methods.name: determineDescriptorType
methods.description: Determines descriptor type based on line content.

methods.name: getShaderInfo
methods.description: Reads a shader source file and extracts descriptor info, tile size, storage types, and registration info.

methods.name: generateSpvBinStr
methods.description: Reads a SPIR-V binary file and generates a C++ array string representation.

methods.name: generateShaderInfoStr
methods.description: Creates a C++ string for registering shader info, including tile size, layouts, and storage types.

methods.name: generateShaderDispatchStr
methods.description: Creates a C++ string for registering shader operation dispatches.

methods.name: genCppFiles
methods.description: Generates C++ source code files for shader registration based on SPIR-V binaries and shader info.
